record.one_liner: Developer API that connects apps to users' bank accounts and financial data.
record.auth_notes: Every request uses a client_id plus secret pair from the Dashboard. The OAuth endpoints are for Plaid's own token grants (client_credentials, refresh_token, e.g. the mcp:dashboard scope), not a third-party user-consent flow for developers.
record.access_notes: Sign up in the Dashboard to get Sandbox API keys for free. critic: access self_serve_free confirmed (free Sandbox issues working keys). Pricing page lists Pay as You Go with no commitment and self-service support.
record.api_notes: Documented HTTP API with per-product endpoints; the pricing page lists core products plus all products including beta on custom plans.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready -> ready_with_review, main_blocker none -> app_review. Sandbox is self-serve and buildable now; live Production use requires Plaid's production access review (from general knowledge; not confirmed on a fetched page, so treat as medium confidence).
